description: Piorun Kulisty, ball lightning come alive, a big crackling sphere of bright blue-white electricity with a fierce glowing face inside it, jagged lightning bolts shooting out in all directions like arms, sparks around it, an abstract creature, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, floating, full body, the creature alone, no clouds, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
